beats.narration: That pop from your exhaust when you let off the gas isn't just loud.
beats.visualPrompt: Rear three-quarter shot of a sedan or hatchback decelerating on a quiet residential street at dusk, static-mounted low camera near the tailpipe, brake-light glow implying the driver has lifted off the throttle.

beats.narration: A bang or backfire on deceleration — not every time, but enough to notice.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on the exhaust tip with a subtle heat-shimmer/vapor puff timed to an implied pop (no flame, no visible ignition — heat distortion only, platform-safe), static mount.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two ~2.5s sub-shots before real generation to satisfy the 1.5-2.5s visual-change cadence.

beats.narration: One clue: unburned fuel igniting late, in the exhaust instead of the cylinder.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro cutaway shot of an engine-bay vacuum hose with a visible hairline crack, slow push-in, dim under-hood lighting, static mount.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (wide + macro push-in) before real generation.

beats.narration: That can point to a vacuum leak, a misfire, or a mixture running rich.
beats.visualPrompt: Wide underbody shot of the exhaust system's midpipe with a faint tailpipe vapor wisp, cut to a spark plug resting on a workbench showing carbon fouling.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (underbody wide + workbench macro) before real generation.

beats.narration: Don't guess which one. A scan and a listen can narrow it down fast.
beats.visualPrompt: Engine-bay inspection shot: a diagnostic scan-tool cable connected to an OBD-II port under the dash, indicator LED glow, cable self-supporting/clipped in frame — no hand visible.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots before real generation.

beats.narration: Worth checking before a pop becomes a bigger exhaust or engine repair. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold.
beats.postCompositing: Real logo and CTA text overlay added in post via ffmpeg, never AI-generated.
